activationRequires: buyer, recipient, destination and importer-of-record identified
destination import, food-labelling and carrier eligibility checked
item price, packing, carrier, tracking, insurance, duties, taxes, clearance and last-mile allocation quoted
delivery window, risk of loss, inspection, acceptance and remedies agreed
final total, currency and quote expiry accepted by both parties
evidenceRequired: label, batch or lot details available to the seller
digests binding inspectable evidence to the quoted unit
recoveryTermsRequired: unavailable buyer, seller, carrier, escrower or administrator
failClosed: Any absent, uncertain, expired or contradicted requirement keeps the offer enquiry-only and suppresses payment, escrow and delivery instructions.
